name: Exp_FigurelliSeries
summary: This EA trades based on the Figurelli Series indicator, which uses a basket of Moving Averages with varying periods to determine trend direction. It opens positions at a specified start time and closes them either by opposing signals or at a specified stop time. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot, free margin, and balance-based calculations.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Figurelli Series指标进行交易，该指标使用不同周期的移动平均线组合来判断趋势方向。EA在指定时间开仓，并通过反向信号或指定时间平仓。仓位管理支持多种保证金模式，包括固定手数、可用保证金和余额比例等。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Figurelli Series指标，该指标通过计算多条不同周期的移动平均线（从iStartPeriod开始，以iStep为步长，共iTotal条）来综合判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标值大于0时产生买入信号，当指标值小于0时产生卖出信号，但仅在用户指定的开仓时间（StartHour:StartMinute）才实际执行开仓。出场条件包括两种：一是收到反向指标信号时平仓，二是到达指定的平仓时间（StopHour:StopMinute）时强制平仓所有仓位。仓位管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数，支持固定手数和基于保证金比例的动态手数计算。资金管理通过MM参数控制投入比例，并支持多种保证金计算模式（FREEMARGIN、BALANCE、LOSSFREEMARGIN、LOSSBALANCE、LOT）。EA还设置了止损和止盈参数，以及最大价格偏差限制来控制滑点风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Figurelli Series indicator, which calculates multiple Moving Averages with varying periods (starting from iStartPeriod, incrementing by iStep, totaling iTotal MAs) to synthesize trend direction. Entry conditions: when the indicator value is greater than 0, a buy signal is generated; when less than 0, a sell signal is generated, but actual trade execution only occurs at the user-specified opening time (StartHour:StartMinute). Exit conditions include two mechanisms: closing on opposing indicator signals, and forced closing of all positions at the specified stop time (StopHour:StopMinute). Position sizing uses the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, supporting both fixed lot sizes and dynamic lot calculation based on margin ratios. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter which sets the deposit share per deal, with multiple margin calculation modes available (FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE, LOT). The EA also implements stop loss and take profit parameters in points, along with a maximum price deviation setting to control slippage risk.

pros: 使用多条移动平均线组合判断趋势，信号相对稳健，减少单一均线滞后性的影响
具有完整的时间窗口控制，可限定交易时段，避免低流动性时段交易
支持多种资金管理模式和止损止盈设置，风险控制手段较为完善
pros_en: Uses a basket of multiple Moving Averages for trend determination, producing relatively robust signals that mitigate single MA lag effects
Provides complete time window control to restrict trading to specified sessions, avoiding low-liquidity periods
Supports multiple money management modes with stop loss and take profit settings, offering fairly comprehensive risk controls
cons: 指标信号仅在指定开仓时间执行，可能导致错过最佳入场时机，策略时效性受限
时间窗口平仓逻辑中存在运算符优先级问题（tm.hour==StopHour && tm.min>=StopMinute || tm.hour>StopHour），可能导致非预期行为
依赖自定义iCustom指标，若FigurelliSeries指标未正确安装则EA无法运行，增加了部署复杂度
cons_en: Indicator signals are only executed at the specified opening time, potentially missing optimal entry points and limiting strategy timeliness
The time-based closing logic has an operator precedence issue (tm.hour==StopHour && tm.min>=StopMinute || tm.hour>StopHour) that could cause unintended behavior
Depends on a custom iCustom indicator; if the FigurelliSeries indicator is not properly installed, the EA cannot run, increasing deployment complexity
improvements: 修复时间判断逻辑中的运算符优先级问题，添加括号确保正确的条件组合
增加点差过滤和最低盈利点数检查，避免在交易成本过高的条件下入场
improvements_en: Fix the operator precedence issue in the time judgment logic by adding parentheses to ensure correct condition grouping
Add spread filtering and minimum profit point checks to avoid entering trades when transaction costs are too high

risk_points: 时间平仓逻辑的运算符优先级问题可能导致仓位在非预期时间被平仓
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不必要的亏损交易
止损设为1000点相对较大，可能在极端行情下造成较大单笔亏损
risk_points_en: Operator precedence issue in time-based closing logic could cause positions to be closed at unintended times
Lack of spread filtering may result in unnecessary losing trades in high-spread environments
Stop loss of 1000 points is relatively large and could cause significant single-trade losses in extreme market conditions
